train125_lr_transfer.blocker: No indexed TRAIN-125 branch, PR, commit, or retained evidence artifact was recoverable at preregistration time; absolute LR candidates and the transfer control recipe must not be invented.

train194_clipping.blocker: No accepted TRAIN-194 clipping decision is published. RECOVER-180 still states that no clipping result is claimed and remains blocked on an accepted non-pathological 10M clipping decision.

train48_beta2.limitation: Every observed small-scale update clipped, so second-moment transfer interpretation is confounded by clipping saturation.
train48_beta2.reason: 0.95 is the incumbent control and 0.99 is the only small-scale endpoint with a repeatable directional quality signal; 0.98 remains a predeclared rescue midpoint rather than reopening a three-way search immediately.

freeze_contract.rule: All non-LR/beta2 controls must be immutable before any optimizer update. Unknown values remain blockers rather than being filled from unrelated historical recipes.

stage_a_lr_transfer.purpose: Select within a narrow log-symmetric neighborhood around the exact TRAIN-125 10M LR prediction while holding beta2 at the incumbent 0.95.

stage_b_beta2_transfer.purpose: At the Stage-A selected LR, compare the incumbent beta2 against the strongest surviving small-scale transfer candidate.

stage_c_conditional_midpoint.trigger: Only if beta2=0.99 is classified UNSTABLE while beta2=0.95 is stable and the Stage-B quality/time-to-quality evidence still leaves a material unresolved tradeoff. The midpoint must then use at least three paired seeds; it cannot be introduced post hoc for a one-seed reversal.

decision_contract.promotion_rule: Only a CLEAR_WIN under the current paired materiality/uncertainty rules may change the 10M experimental optimizer default. PRACTICAL_TIE retains the less intrusive incumbent; UNSTABLE or INSUFFICIENT_REPEATS cannot promote.

truth_boundary.reason: TRAIN-125 LR authority and TRAIN-194 clipping authority are both missing.
